description: The role of flexibility in future European sector-coupled energy system (model and data) is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Théo Balanza, Rasmus Bramstoft (Technical University of Denmark). Overview This repository contains the code, input data, model and results related to the manuscript "The role of flexibility in future European sector-coupled energy system", currently in the reviewal process. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
